question: im in canggu this weekend, anywhere good to eat and is there anything on i should know about?

response.message:
good timing, this is the sounds project weekend (tomorrow through sunday) if you're into live music and that kind of scene. that's the main thing on, it's across [bali](kebi://area/id/bali) but worth knowing about if you want to catch something.

for eating, the weekend in [canggu](kebi://area/id/bali/canggu) is really about the nightlife spots that double as restaurants. your main move is [vault](kebi://venue/7861b346-2a73-4a7a-a66c-b58840527758) on saturday night - that's their big night, runs wed to sat so saturday is the one to hit. proper underground vibe, cocktails, good energy.

sunday is [sand bar](kebi://venue/f01f4435-631c-41e9-a3a9-f05356eb82c2)'s day, beachfront and more relaxed than vault. it's the casual sunday spot, good if you want something less intense than saturday. [old man's](kebi://venue/45a09352-bfd6-403a-b5c5-7b23699a1ce2) runs every night if you want a laid back beach bar feel with live music, that's your in-between spot any of the three nights.

[motel mexicola](kebi://venue/8099938c-7730-4890-93e1-bd333d3a8ffa) is the big party venue but that's really a tuesday thing, you're a few days early for their night.

what kind of food are you actually after - casual beach vibes, something more upscale, or just wherever the energy is good?
